parameters.query:
UPDATE public.help_questions
   SET rating            = $2::smallint,
       feedback          = COALESCE($3, feedback),
       resolution_status = CASE WHEN $2::smallint = -1 THEN 'open' ELSE resolution_status END
 WHERE id = $1::uuid
   AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = $4::uuid)
RETURNING id, rating;
